title: Sunward customer onboarding: setup tidbits and run-dump
content:
Purpose:
Quick, messy daily scratchpad for Sunward (retail analytics) private deployment. Personal running notes, commands to try, config heuristics, open questions for SE sync. Not for customer circulation yet — pared-down bits will be copy-pasted into the official runbook later.

High-level goal:
- Get private (VPC) deployment into Sunward staging (region: us-west-2) with model gallery access limited to curated models and KMS-backed keys.
- Verify latency < 120ms p50 for 128-token responses on small concurrency (burst 10).

Live checklist (prioritize):
1) Networking
   - [ ] Confirm peering with sunward-prod-vpc (security asked for new peering, they want transitive blocks)
   - [x] Create customer-vpn appliance instance (done 2026-02-25)
   - TODO: get route table CIDR they will accept for our subnets (asked Slack #sunward-ops)

2) Secrets & keys
   - KMS alias: projects/sunward/keys/rw-kms-sunward (need CMK policy review)
   - Action: request key ACL from Sunward security (Samir) — ticket JIRA-SUN-3124

3) Deployment config (private)
   - cluster profile: private-medium (4xA10g equivalent)
   - autoscale policy: min=2, max=8, cooldown=3m
   - suggested quantization: q4_0 for the 7B family for cost/latency tradeoff
   - experiment: try q5_0 on a canary node for latency measurement

Important commands & snippets (notes, not copy/paste for prod):
- bootstrap the control plane locally (mac):
  ./infra/bin/bootstrap-local --env sunward-staging --region us-west-2 --profile sunward-ops

- apply customer config (kustomize):
  kustomize build overlays/sunward-staging | kubectl apply -f -

- quick curl test for health endpoint (token redacted):
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private-api.sunward.redwood-infer/health | jq

Observability checklist (first pass):
- Confirm per-route tracing enabled in control plane (env var RW_TRACE=1)
- Verify token-level cost logs flow to S3 bucket sunward-telemetry-logs with path prefix /staging/
- Add a temporary dashboard for model: redwood/red-7b-q4 on console: latency, errors, token-rate

Customer config caveats/decisions to log:
- Sunward insists on no external model fetching. We must ship curated model tarball via signed image. Action: coordinate with model-onboarding to produce an approved image.
- They also require 90-day key rotation cadence. Ask security if automatic rotation available.

Open questions / blockers (for SE sync):
- Can sunward accept our recommended subnet mask for autoscaling subnets? Security replied ambiguous. (Action: Samir to escalate to their netops)
- Does sunward want the control plane still hosted by Redwood or self-hosted? Their compliance hinted at self-hosted control plane for prod. If self-hosted, impact: extra ops runbook + support tier required.
- SLA needs clarification: they requested 99.9% for regional nodes but also want burst capacity — need to propose trade-offs and pricing.

Testing plan (short):
- Phase A: smoke — deploy one node, validate model load and health, basic inference correctness (sanity prompts)
- Phase B: perf — run 10k token-load test across 3 clients, monitor p50/p95 and OOMs
- Phase C: reliability — simulate graceful degradation (kill model-server, fallback to smaller variant) and verify fallbacks and metrics

Quick notes from yesterday call (2026-03-10):
- Ops lead (Tara) needs VPC peer config by 03/16 to avoid slip
- Compliance asked for audit trail retention to 12 months (default is 90d) — need pricing impact calc
- They will provide KMS CMK policy draft by next Wed

Temporary heuristics / suggestions (my brain-dump):
- Start with q4 on the 7b -> saves ~35% memory, should keep p50 under 110ms at low concurrency. Q5 might add instability on some kernels.
- Prefer sticky routing to warm nodes for session-heavy retail queries (cart completion).
- Cache prefixes for common prompts: create a small caching tier at edge for high-volume prefix: e.g., "search product" flows.

To do (me):
- [ ] Draft brief for pricing impact of 12mo audit retention (by 2026-03-12)
- [ ] Push PR with kustomize overlay updates (PR #987) — add kube tolerations for A10g nodes
- [ ] Confirm KMS policy format and send example to Sunward security
- [ ] Run perf job with q4 vs q5 on staging (Samir + me) — target run 2026-03-12

Tidbits / friction log (keep short):
- Sunward network team prefers human-signed RT entries which slows automation. Consider a manual step in onboarding runbook.
- Their legal asked about data residency: confirm that telemetry S3 will be in us-west-2 only (not cross-region).

If I forget things, quick reference:
- Jira: JIRA-SUN-3124 (onboarding epic)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployments/pull/987
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/team-soleng/sunward-onboard

Notes to self: copy final checklist to shared runbook path: shared_drives/company/misc/onboarding-runbooks/sunward after 1st successful deploy. Keep this file as a scratch until then.

End of dump.
